title: Astra Lost in Space
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In 2063 nine students from Caird High School leave for a planet camp, but a mysterious sphere of light flings them thousands of light-years into space. Finding an old abandoned ship they name Astra, they plan a long trip home across alien planets, managing scarce resources while secrets about their families and a traitor among them come out (Wikipedia; MU; Viz blurb via AniList).
life_message: Teens hurt or neglected by their parents can become a true family by trusting and relying on each other.

content.note: Attack by the sphere; Ulgar carries a gun and seeks revenge for his brother (Wikipedia); MU Traitor/s, Attempted dangers.
Survival on alien planets, conspiracy and twists (AniList Survival, Tragedy; MU Suspense, Stranded).
Romantic subplot (MU); AniList Nudity at low rank (13%).
Yun-Hua emotionally suppressed by her mother; Quitterie neglected by hers (Wikipedia).

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Ulgar's revenge quest is one strand; crew resolves conflicts by talking (Wikipedia; to verify).

Order vs freedom.evidence: Teens escape parental control and run their own ship (Wikipedia).

Civic vs kin.evidence: Found family replaces biological families who failed them (AniList Found Family).

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Captain Kanata leads, but roles are by skill and consent (Wikipedia).

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Science-driven survival; cloning and conspiracy (MU Clone/s, Conspiracy).

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Resource survival, yet Yun-Hua finds her voice and Kanata his dream (Wikipedia).

folkways.japan: A school trip framing and the pressure of high-achieving parents on children echo Japanese school and family expectations, though the setting is international.

delivery.evidence: Sources say nothing on delivery (to verify); summaries show themes revealed through backstories and twists.

delivery.note: The critique of controlling parents appears to come through mystery reveals rather than lectures, as far as summaries show.

winners_losers: The nine students survive and bond as a family; parents who used them lose sympathy. The favored worldview is chosen solidarity over inherited status.
